headline: Missile Command gets the arcade hot-seat
lede: Press 2 at the title and the waves start alternating — you take the odd ones, the CPU gunner takes the even ones, and the cities are shared, so a burn on your wave costs your partner too.

notes.text: Two-player alternating (#3630): dual-score HUD with the on-duty player blinking, per-seat ledgers (25/125/bonus all pay the live seat), winner board over both books — and a friend can seize seat 2 mid-raid on WASD + F.
Pad fix: arrow keys now actually aim the crosshair — the controls line promised it since the port while the keys sat dead. Phones get stick-to-aim on every wave.
Solo play is byte-identical: the hot-seat adds no dice, and a 5000-tick replay is equal to the pre-2P sim — all 24-seed sweeps still clear waves 1–5 untouched.
Proven again in real Chrome: the CPU seat defended its wave with six cities standing and booked its bonus, and off-duty clicks spend nothing.

look.text: Press 2 (or tap 2P — VS CPU) and hold the odd waves
PAC-MAN's fruit ladder still marks the rounds
